name: Mihai Popescu
bio:
Mihai's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, while volunteering at a local rally event in his youth. The roar of the engines and the meticulous teamwork captivated him, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. He honed his skills at a small engineering firm before transitioning to a Formula 3 team, where he quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a knack for optimizing operational efficiency and fostering team cohesion.

At Trident, Mihai is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the team's operational activities, from logistics and resource allocation to ensuring seamless coordination between departments. He is known for his pragmatic approach, always seeking practical solutions to complex problems and prioritizing clear communication. Mihai's flexibility and commitment to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to the team, always willing to adapt strategies based on changing circumstances.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Mihai is of average height with a slightly stocky build.
